translations.web: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.
translations.bsb: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
translations.kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
